articleTitle: Microwave frequency harmonics filter on semiconcentrated elements

articleTitle: Designing interference generator for blocking CDMA standard operation
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering

publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Capabilities of colour television data transfer modeling by labview are demonstrated. Special attention is paid to power amplifier non-linearity correction.

articleTitle: Improved calculation algorithm of diode balanced frequency multiplier
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering

articleTitle: Bending of long rectangular cross-section multilayered plate caused by temperature change

articleTitle: New method of respiratory biofeedback control based on pneumograms

The errors of achieved significance levels evaluation under using “classical” Fisher's distribution in this conditions have been given.

articleTitle: Management methodology of technology system of production

articleTitle: Sonar ray's electronic control
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The method is considered and results of working out of sonar ray's electronic control device and in particular echo-sounding device are produced.

articleTitle: Noise of varactor frequency multipliers
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Sources of noise in varactor frequency multipliers are considered. publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering

articleTitle: PI and PID controller design for nonlinear systems in the presence of a time delay via singular perturbation technique
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The paper treat a question of proportional-integral and proportional-integral-derivative (PM) controller design for nonlinear same in the presence of a time delay, plant's parameter variations, and unknown external disturbances. The design of a universal controller, which is an extension of PI (PID) controller, I discussed as well The presented design methodology guarantees desired output transient performance indices by inducing of two-time-scale motions in the closed loop system. Stability conditions imposed on the fast and slow mode and sufficiently large mode separation rate between fast and slow modes can ensure that the full-order closed-loop nonlinear system achieves the desired properties in such a way that the output transient performances are desired and insensitive to external disturbances and plant's parameter variations. The method of singular perturbations is used throughout the paper in order to got explicit expressions for evaluation of the controller parameters. Numerical examples with simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: PI and PID controller design for nonlinear systems in the presence of a time delay via singular perturbation technique

abstract: The paper treats a question of proportional-integral (PI) and proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controllers design for nonlinear systems in the presence of a time delay, plant's parameter variations, and unknown external disturbances. Numerical examples with simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: On new formulas for line form and natural linewidth in semiconductor lasers

abstract: New formulas for laser mode line form and effective natural linewidth in semiconductor lasers are derived using the formula for laser frequency, depending on the field amplitude. New linewidth formula is presented in dimensionless values and is functionally different from Schawlow-Townes formula. The formula derived allows explaining some experimental measurements of the linewidth.

articleTitle: Teaching power electronics and drive control to Non-Electrical-Engineering students
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Electrical engineering and here especially the power side is an important topic in today's engineering curricula. Through Bologna Process, curricula had to be shortened by 25 % but additional contents were to be included. Thus education must become more efficient. Non-electrical engineering students shall get application oriented knowledge and competence in variable speed drives. Power electronics is the decisive part but hard to understand if basics in electrical engineering as well as power electronics are taught with only few lecture hours. The proposed method relies on practical experience of teaching advanced power electronics and drive at a university where no electrical engineering curriculum exists. Teaching must be supported strongly by good lecture material prepared for the described target group.

articleTitle: Revitalization, performance measurement, and improvement of electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Electric vehicles from industrial production exist since more than 80 years. State-of-the-art cars go back 20 years at maximum. Research on electric vehicles is done by car manufacturers, small and large companies, and on universities. For university institutes with restricted means, independent research on electric vehicles is done on older and warn out versions of industrially converted vehicles. To get a basis for comparison and a research platform the old vehicle needs to be revitalized especially concerning the batteries. A measurement system for electrical and mechanical, thermal and/or environmental values is implemented to obtain precise results of practical operation. Improvements on battery system, power converter, cable connections, and even drive motor are systematically planned executed, and evaluated. The whole process is described In this paper.

articleTitle: New sight at an old problem of quality of electric energy, of power converters
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The problem of interaction of electronics power converters with load and power supplies continues to remain actual because of extending application of power converters and for the lack of its general comprehensible analytical decisions. Here it is possible to allocate three basic aspects of this problem. First, influence of no sinusoidal output voltage of the converter on load. Second, return influence of a no sinusoidal input current single power converter on the power supply. Thirdly, interaction in an obvious kind by means of return influence of no sinusoidal input currents several power converters on a power line in a point of common connection (PCC). The spectral approach actively is developed and is widely used today for the decision of these problems. We develop the uniform integrated approach to all specified problems on the basis of author's direct methods of calculation (not demanding decisions of the differential equations) of known and new parameters of electromagnetic compatibility of power converters. It is offered to enter into standards on quality of electric energy family of integrated and differential factors of harmonics of a voltage and a current

Author Keywords: standards on quality of electric energy

articleTitle: μP controlled power electronics static double-spark ignition for historic combustion engine
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the performance of a historic combustion engine, the machine is equipped with o double spark ignition system. For control of this system and for further Improvement of the operating quality of the ignition, the conventional mechanical controller parts are replaced by a μP controlled system, containing a PIC® from MicroChip®, several measuring devices and power electronics section of special design for actuation of the ignition coils. To maintain the historic appearance of the vehicle, the fuel mixture generation is still done by carburetors. This education project is an opportunity for the student to learn about miscellaneous sensors and measurement amplifiers, to program a sequence control system with accurate timing on a microcontroller and to design a current controlling power section for loading and unloading the ignition coils.

articleTitle: Microstrip radiopulse protection device

The definition of the minimal and maximal values of wave resistance of a short-circuited irregular line of transfer on the set spectrum of a line is considered in the paper that will allow to apply various methods of optimization, imposing restrictions on a physical reliability of an irregular line of transfer. Settlement values of wave resistance difference are compared to the values received on deduced approximative formula.

articleTitle: 3D modeling of nonstationary electromagnetic fields with the help of finite element method in the problems of electrical survey
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The problem of nonstationary three-dimensional electromagnetic fields modeling in the problems of electrical survey with the use of the finite element method, which uses vector-scalar definition with the nodal basic functions on the parallele piped finite elements is considered in the present work. A scalar magnetic potential is introduced in the air and vector potential - in all other areas. To assign the source in the scalar potential the potential fracture method is used.

articleTitle: Calculation of the converter elements by electronic simulator of formulas
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: On faculty of industrial electronics NSTU some years works on creation of all a component of the electronic training environment at the discipline Lt Fundamentals of power electronics Gt are conducted. The electronic textbook with the electronic test, computer versions of laboratory works, electronic databases has been created. The specified stage of education can be executed by the student without the help of the teacher. The following problem in automation of training consists now in clearing the teacher of routine work on check at each student of variants of his practical calculations of electric parameters of converter elements. It can be made by creation of a simulator of mathematical formulas of such calculations. Complex nonsinusoidal forms of voltages and currents in converters cause difficulties in students at construction of settlement formulas of integrated values for such forms. At independent studying bases of power electronics the software realizing functions of a simulator is developed.

articleTitle: Transverse piezoresistance in nanosize piezoresistors
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering

The analytic description of the effect of shear strain, caused by free faces of the piezoresistor, on the normal strains epsiv<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and epsiv<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is presented. articleTitle: Automated analysis of control results of radio-electronic devices during mass production
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Software for automated collection and analysis of results of radio-electronic devices during mass production control has been developed. By means of this software tasks of building databases of measured parameters with attributes characterizing the device and measurement process are solved. Gathered data array are analyzed with help of contained in a software instruments for quality control in compliance with standard ISO part ldquostatic methodsrdquo. The example of applying software in real production conditions is given.

articleTitle: More better of balanced diode frequency multiplier
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In this work we give the algorithm for balanced diode frequency multiplier at coupled TEM line. The algorithm proved to be correct under frequency multiplier development, this makes it to estimate a characteristic with minimal adjustment.

articleTitle: On the method of nonstationary electromagnetic fields modeling
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The problem of modeling three-dimensional no stationary electromagnetic fields is considered. A mixed vector variational formulation, a modified mixed vector variational formulation and a vector variational formulation for a system of the Maxwell equations are constructed on a basis of the vector finite element method. Numerical study on class of problems, having known smooth analytical solution is performed.

articleTitle: Variant of classification of rectifiers to topological attributes
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The variant of classification of the rectifiers, based on topological attributes of converting parts is offered. Base topology of two parts of rectifiers: transformer converters of number and shift of phases and diodes and thyristors schemes are certain. Examples of classification of circuit decisions of rectifiers are resulted.

articleTitle: Investigation of pulse width signals multipliers
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: New method for multiplication of two pulse-width modulated signal is proposed. Advantages of this method are demonstrated. States when truncations error is null was founded. A bundle of experiments with this method are realized and results of investigation are presented. The ways of improvement of this method is suggested and effectiveness of such improvements is proved.

articleTitle: Functional role of pulse pressure of blood in the transcapillary exchange
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the physical mechanisms of transcapillary exchange of the living organism are investigated. Laboratory animals are the object of this investigation, and original laser and electrophysiological methods are used as experimental tools.

articleTitle: Measurement of the surface relief by the holographic method
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: During this work experimental test samples have been investigated. Holographic topograms written down by a method of the displaced source are deciphered by means of the special software package developed on at the faculty. The received three-dimensional models of objects allow define to the value of the height of the allocated point.

articleTitle: An optimization SVPWM technique for the NPC converters
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes an optimization SVPWM technique for the neutral point clamped converters with taking the DC-voltage unbalance into consideration.

articleTitle: The method of revealing radiotransmitters and increasing of radiominotoring validity
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The report discussed the problem of creation of small size effective systems for revealing radio transmitters in a close zone with compound form of modulation.

articleTitle: Is it possible to make materials with ionic super conductivity? Part II
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The basic idea is that we try to find some materials in which bosonic ions with sufficiently small effective mass are used as charge carriers instead of Cooper's pairs in order to provide high temperature ionic superconductivity. Ionic crystals LiCl, LiF, LiBr and LiI were considered with lithium isotope Li<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>. Calculations show that Bose condensation temperature for lithium ions in these crystals is of the order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-34</sup> -10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-43</sup>K. If, however, the crystal is compressed so that the wave functions of neighboring lithium ions are sufficiently overlapped, then Bose-condensation temperature of Li<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>-ions can be increased significantly. Our estimates show that compressing the crystals by 20-22% in all three directions one can raise the Bose-condensation temperature in all crystals considered to above room temperature. To realize materials with room temperature superconductivity in practice the use of molecular beam epitaxy is proposed for the formation of heterostructures from thin and thick layers of thought-fully-chosen composition.

articleTitle: New mode interaction mechanism in four-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: For the first time it was experimentally demonstrated the interaction of core modes in 4-core fiber with large distance between the cores (28 mum). It was established that the effect of interaction is very sensitive to the fiber curving. The effect explanation based on indirect interaction of the cores inside the fiber through the central shell mode is given. The 70% energy transfer from one core to another was obtained for 40 cm long fiber.

articleTitle: Femtosecond fiber laser for linear measurements
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: An optical standard of length, which allows measuring lengths from one meter to hundreds kilometers, was proposed and realized on basis of a femtosecond Erbium fiber laser with hybrid linear-ring cavity design.

articleTitle: Features of risk's management of hi-tech medical products manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: [Summary form only given] Risk management system at the preparation and organization of medical product batch production is created with a view to ensuring, on the one hand, the maximum safety and efficacy (specialization of the application) of medical product, and on the other hand, extensive application, providing strong demand for this product and the minimum cost of the production. Feasibility study for a risk management plan includes the analysis of the identified risk sources, development and approval to a route and control methods at all stages of the technological cycle.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the method of increasing the noise immunity of the invariant system of information processing
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The previous research was devoted to the calculation of the indications of the invariant system with the expanded synchronous detector and using the subcarrier. In the given article the methods of increasing the noise immunity of the invariant system are considered.

articleTitle: Simulation of three level inverter with four leg
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The paper presents an urgent problem of modem aircraft power supply development. Paper proposes three level inverter with four leg for frequency converter systems. Simulation results and analysis are presented.

articleTitle: Radio jamming development for stoppage standard CDMA
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In work the problem of a choice of a modulating signal for formation of a handicap with the necessary form of a spectrum is examined. The existing ways of protection are based on formation of a handicap, which spectrum - continuous. For reduction of expenses and increase of efficiency it is offered to form streaky a spectrum.

articleTitle: Mechanism of medical diagnostics data integration
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Due to a wide application of the information systems for automation administrative and financial activities to healthcare establishments, an actual problem is to use previously collected data, especially in the area of medical diagnostics and its. further utilization in treatment process. The paper describes several ways to medical diagnostics data representation and methods of its integration with clinical information system.

articleTitle: In a period compensation characteristics in the pulsed noise censoring systems
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The systems of radar LFM signals coherent packet processing with pulsed noise (PN) censoring at the input, of matched filter (MF) and signals, reflected from local subjects (LS), in a period compensation (IPC) are considered. Characteristics of LS, PN signals suppression in IPC, target signals detection and permission are obtained. For PN, which power lower than LS signals power, censoring reliability increase, it's offered to produce IPC of uncompressed LFM signals before PN censor.

articleTitle: Development and investigation vector control system of doubly-fed induction motor
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a method for development the electric drive system control based on doubly-fed induction motor. The mathematical models of controlled electric drive, the structure of vector control system by the rotor circuit, the ways of control action formation are also considered. The results of digital simulation are presented.

articleTitle: Invariant system for processing of information by non-coherent reception and its quantitative characteristics
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The invariant system of processing of information based on the linear detector is considered. The quantitative estimation of the noise immunity of such kind of system with its further comparison with the noise immunity of ordinary binary system by non-coherent reception is carried out.

articleTitle: Difference - time processing characteristics in systems with pulse noise censoring
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Systems of LFM radar signals coherent packet processing with pulsed noise (PN) censoring at the input of matched filter (MF) and frequency threshold (FT), provided low level of false alarm probability from signals, reflected from point moving clutter (PMC), are considered. Characteristics of moving target signals detection are obtained and values of false alarm rate from PMC in conditions of simultaneously influencing PN are determined.

articleTitle: Influence of temperature on spectral dependence of optical absorption in crystal Bi12SiO20
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The spectral dependences of optical absorption in the wavelength range 450…1100 nm and temperature range 23…70°C for the bismuth silicate crystal are considered. To describe the experimental dependencies of the impurity absorption the model of photo-excitation of electrons from deep levels to conduction band was used.

articleTitle: Powerful semiconductor laser bars on 950 nm for pulse energy greater 200MJ
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In present work the possibility of manufacturing, of semiconductor laser bars with emitting power up to 50 W at a wavelength of 950 nanometers with an injection current pulse duration up to 4 msec with high duty factor is shown.

articleTitle: The noise immunity of Invariant relative amplitude modulation
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The Invariant system of information transmission can be based on the know principle of relative amplitude modulation. By calculating the noise immunity of such kind of system the ratio of information modulated parameter to the reference modulated parameter is used. In the given article the analysis of the noise immunity of such system is carried out and it is compared with the nose immunity of know kinds of modulation.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of cylindrical and multi-sectional ultra sonic irradiators for intra-cavity treatment
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Results of the comparative analysis of two ultrasonic irradiators (USI) for intra-cavity treatment are presented. The first USI is multi-section consisting of 4 peizoceramic plates placed on lateral surface of a flexible medical catheter parallel to each other. The second USI is a piezoceramic cylinder built in the same catheter. It is shown that 4-section irradiator provides lower intensity compared with the cylinder irradiator. Non-uniformity of intensity distribution over the lateral surface of the cavity for 4-section irradiator reaches 25% in 1mm thickness biological tissue (the cylinder irradiator has non-uniformity close to 0%). With increase of biological tissue thickness the intensity of 4-section USI decreases faster and its non-uniformity decreases as well. For the thickness of 5mm intensities of both USI are almost equal. With increase of tissue exposition time the resistance of the tissue changes more under irradiation of the cylinder USI.

articleTitle: System parameters identification ≪Autonomous underwater vehicle - external environment≫
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a identification scheme for a number of «autonomous underwater vehicle — external environment» dynamical system parameters such as motor rotating parts moment of inertia with allowance for additional moments of inertia and viscous friction coefficient. We show simulation results that illustrate the high convergence speed of parameters to true values.

articleTitle: Control systems synthesis method based on adaptive inverse models

articleTitle: The hypothesis test about structure variations in the fuzzy regression models

In the paper consider that the F-test distribution are influence not only of error of observations distribution, but also of method of estimation model parameters, namely, consider least squares method and robust method for estimated of model parameters. articleTitle: Block approach to analysis and synthesis of linear dynamic systems
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The problem of “large dimension” is appearing with feedback synthesis in multidimensional dynamic systems. Using of decomposition methods allows one to overcome this problem. On the basis of these forms decomposition principle is realized validly with synthesis of fundamental problems such as stabilization, invariance, observation and tracking.

articleTitle: One approach of adaptive stabilization the system with piecewise-continuous disturbance
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering

The object model consists of matrix gains which change at switched time. This objects use as models of computing and control theory. We studied the system properties and give a condition to choose the adaptor gains.

articleTitle: Measurement of displacement parameters of UHF devices elements by interference method using neural network technologies for information processing
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: To obtain accurate displacement data for the objects with non-flat surface by UHF interference method using 3 probes the neural network technologies were used. The real experiments were made. To provide quadratic characteristic of the detectors the calibration using the developed mathematical model of neural network was performed. Combining UHF interference method with neural network technologies increased accuracy of displacement parameters measurement.

articleTitle: Algorithm for processing channel communication data with variable parameters
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering

articleTitle: Increase the capacity RSTE due to improvement of algorithm of work of a subsystem of the asynchronous equipment
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The topology of notices transfer radio-system (RSTE) is considered at this paper, the algorithm of its work is analyzed. The program of modeling by means of which numerical experiments are lead is approved. With help modeling results schedules are constructed and drawn conclusions.

articleTitle: Group of bridge circuits based on frequency independent two-pole elements
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering

These two-pole elements also are based on 4-arm bridge circuits with three-element two-pole elements having reactive elements in two comparison arms.

articleTitle: Low cost cogging torque elimination at PMSM by power electronics control
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Highest efficiency can be obtained by a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (PMSM) drive. Simple and cost effective PMSM designs with automatically wound stator coils and therefore without stater skewing exhibit high cogging torque values coming from slot-tooth and magnet geometry. Skewing is the standard measure to avoid unfavorable cogging torques and it is usually done at rotor side with induction machines but cannot be realized at PMSM in the same way. This paper identifies cogging torque for a specific PMSM with automatically-wound stator without skewing and presents efficient solutions for a complete elimination of inherent cogging torque by advanced power electronics control and suitable power electronics hardware.

articleTitle: Communication channel model in monitoring system of telecommunication network elements in case of fuzzy conditions
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The mathematical Communication channel model on the basis of the theory of indistinct sets is considered in the paper which functions in system of monitoring and diagnostics of a telecommunication network elements conditions. Analytical expressions to estimate Communication channel conditions with help non-statistical methods are obtained.

articleTitle: Design of a two phase power converter for the control of a Transversal Flux Machine
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The transversal-flux-machine (TFM) is a high-pole machine especially suited and developed for low speed and high torque. Its greatest advantage is the simplified stator configuration realized by common ring coils. However, the magnetic design in stator and especially in the rotor is rather complicated. The transversal-flux-machine is a single phase permanent magnet synchronous machine. For continuous torque production, at least two parallel systems are required, therefore. Practically, this means two phases. Control of such a two phase machine requires a customized power converter. This paper describes design of that power converter and includes a possible control structure for that unique machine.

articleTitle: Half-wave stripline resonator on the suspended substrate
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The behavior of own Q-factor and own frequencies of first two fluctuations fashions of the half-wave strip resonator on the suspended substrate from its dielectric permeability and resonator design are investigated. Opportunities of achievement in it of simultaneously extremely high Q-factor and the maximal distinction of the first and second resonances frequencies are shown.

Conclusions and methods of the decision of the given problem are adduced.

abstract: A control chart of adjustment center imbalance of process with low alpha error probability and stability to unknown distribution parameter is designed. At the heart of algorithm is hypothesis check criterion. According to results of current controlled parameter measurements at every step is made a calculation of line inclination value and is tested hypothesis of its equality to null. Structure of the stand includes some generators of fictitious electrical power, containing precious converters of energy in number of pulses. The control of the stand and processing of results of measurements are carried out by the personal computer.

publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering

Dependences of laser radiation power working in a mode of suppression of axial modes from mirrors passing are received. Depending optimum relations of diaphragm diameters and an optical beam in the medium are found.

articleTitle: Experiments on visualization of helical counterflow motion of gas mediums in respiratory system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In this paper, some results of clinical and experimental investigations of the biomechanics of pulmonary ventilation are presented. Direct visualization of the motion of non-homogenous gas media in the human respiratory system during inspiration has been obtained for the first time. The existence of the phenomenon of formation of a helical counterflow of gas media at pulmonary ventilation has been proved experimentally. The results obtained can serve as a basis for the development of new methods of controlled respiration and special apparatuses for use in clinical medicine: anesthesiologY, resuscitation, and intensive care.

articleTitle: Dependence of resistivity on orientation and size for rectangular sample made from conductive rectangular cell net
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Dependence of the resistivity on angle and size for the plane rectangular sample made from the conductive rectangular cell net is considered. It is shown that when the number of the net nodes inside the sample increases and when the ratio of the boundary nodes to the inside nodes decreases the resistivity tends to a value that can be considered as bulk vain for the considered direction. publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In the paper the outcomes of the human stomach healthy and tumoral biotissues coefficients of polarization massifs researches describing parameters of dipole polarization and allowing to distinguish these biotissues are submitted. The advantages of a multifrequency method of biological tissues electrical impedance research having for an object diagnosing of their anatomic and physiological change in comparison with a healthy biotissue are described. The parameters of dipole polarization determining an anatomic and physiological condition of a biotissue are certain. On the basis of aplenty human stomach healthy and tumoral biotissues electrical impedance measurements character of dipole polarization for each of them is defined, that together with the conducted histological researches has allowed to determine correspondence of these biotissues electrical parameters to their anatomic type.

articleTitle: The noise immunity of invariant relative amplitude modulation
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The Invariant System of information transmission can be based on the know principle of relative amplitude modulation. By calculating the noise immunity of such kind of system the ratio of information modulated parameter to the reference modulated parameter is used. In the given article the analysis of the noise immunity of such system is carried out and it is compared with the nose immunity of know kinds of modulation.

articleTitle: Simulation results of Z-source converter for aircraft power supply systems
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The paper deals with urgent problem of promising aircraft power supply development. Z-source converter proposed for frequency converter systems can overcome main disadvantages of existing systems. The paper presents simulation results of proposed power generation system.

articleTitle: In a period compensation characteristics in the pulsed noise censoring system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The system of radar LFM signals coherent packet processing with pulsed noise (PN) censoring at the input of matched filter (MF) and signals, reflected from local subjects (LS), in a period compensation IPC are considered. Characteristics of LS, PN signals suppression in IPC, target signals detection and permission are obtained. For PN, which power lower than LS signals power, censoring reliability increase, it's offered to produce IPC of uncompressed LFM signals before PN censor.

articleTitle: Structure of database designed for diagnostics using Gas Discharge Pictures of Biologically Active Points
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The structure of a database designed for medical diagnostics is considered. The database consists of personal patient data, questionnaire answers, primary examination results, laboratory results, special examination results and GDP BAP (gas discharge pictures on the surface of biologically active points). To help a user the recommendations concerning use of GDP for medical diagnostic are included: the recommendations are based on the analysis of GDP of 120 BAPs. The software for use, extending and changing structure of the database is developed.

articleTitle: On the application of a photo plasma dynamic method for pussy wounds treatment
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: We offer a new photo plasma dynamic method and ELECTRON -PULSAR complex of apparatuses for the implementation of the method. The method and the complex of the apparatuses ensure the treatment for pussy wounds by means of a gaseous mixture effecting on the infection nidus. The gaseous mixture includes the following highly- active components such as O*, O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>* <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, O', the traces of O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> plus ultraviolet etc., and the said mixture is generated by using high voltage electric pulsed discharges that interact with the initial gaseous mixture containing ozone. The photo plasmatic dynamic method and the complex of the apparatuses have been used in clinics in treatment for pussy wounds and body cavities of various etiology.

articleTitle: Difference — time processing characteristics in systems with pulsed noise censoring
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Systems of LFM radar signals coherent packet processing with pulsed noise (PN) censoring at the input of matched filter (MF) and frequency threshold (FT), provided low level of false alarm probability from signals, reflected from point moving clutter (PMC), are considered. Characteristics of moving target signals detection are obtained and values of false alarm rate from PMC in conditions of simultaneously influencing PN are determined.

articleTitle: Invariant echo-compensator of the second order with defensive temporary interval and its features
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The checked structure invariant echo-compensator of the second order with defensive temporary interval. The checked elements of management like echo-compensator. The checked calculation of the main technical features.

articleTitle: The application of the complete coordination set for the calculation of systems with electronic power converters
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The paper is devoted to the application of the method of a complete coordination set (CCS) for the analysis of electric circuits. In particular, the method is applied for the calculation of the electric circuits with electronic power converters. The CCS method is shown to substantially improve stability of the numerical algorithm. We describe the effective numerical algorithm which is based on the CCS method and accounts for the special structure of the coefficient matrix of the system of linear equations.

articleTitle: Electrooptical properties modelling of multidomain liquid crystal structures
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Results theoretical and experimental researches of electrooptical properties of the multidomain crystal structures made with use of surface-active substances are presented.

articleTitle: Measuring system for the registration of pseudo-noise hydroacoustic signals
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In this work we describe a developed FPGA-based measuring system that allows one to register navigational and control pseudo-noise hydro-acoustic signals accurately and in real time. We present experiment results produced with a prototype of the measuring system in a real environment under shallow sea conditions.

articleTitle: Autonomous vehicle control for scalar field measurements
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a gradient control algorithm for autonomous vehicle, allowing to detect and track level curves of a scalar field in the plane. The vehicle can consist one sensor that can take only a single measurement at a time. This leads to ability of calculating only local estimates of scalar field gradient. The motion algorithm is based on additional testing signal in control system and provide overall estimate of gradient.

articleTitle: Group intervals for Rao-Robson-Nikulin's criterion selection with help of noncentrality parameter maximization
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The paper is devoted to the investigation of optimal grouping for Rao-Robson-Nikulin's criteria. The points were found for optimal grouping via noncentrality parameter of statistics distribution maximization under the alternative hypothesis. The comparison with other methods was conducted with the help of computer simulation for two pairs of hypotheses: the first was the case of normal and logistic distribution and the second was the case of two normal distributions with different sample size. The scale parameter was chosen for estimation. Conclusions about criteria statistics distribution under the alternative hypothesis were made by considering simulation results.

articleTitle: Mathematical model and analysis of coal mine technologies processes video-control system
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Summary form only given. Application of mathematical model of video-control system with higher requirements to withstand effect of environment. Optimal transfer parameters are derived taking into account load of transfer channel and image resolution. It is shown that change of the transfer capability of the output channel only slightly depends on the number of the input communication channels but significantly depends on the resolution of the images.

articleTitle: Echo-signal Doppler spectrum modeling from volume-distributed object at reduction turbulence to equivalent modification of antenna diagram directivity
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The way of echo-signal Doppler spectrum simulation from the volumetric-distributed object is considered at turbulent movement of the reflectors, consisting in data of turbulent movement of reflectors in equivalent change of the antenna directivity diagram. The expressions to estimate demanded quantity of reflectors at reduction of turbulent movement in equivalent change of antenna directivity diagram are obtained. Estimations of reflectors demanded quantity are also obtained at echo-signal Doppler spectrum simulation from the turbulent volumetric-distributed object for hypothetical radar station.

articleTitle: Invariant assymetrical echo-compensator and its features
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The Checked structure invariant echo-compensator of the second order with defensive temporary interval. The Checked elements of management like echo-compensator. The Checked calculation of the main technical features.

articleTitle: The use of complex integral criteria for the optimization of regulators for linear objects
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The integral quality criteria for the estimation of closed dynamic feedback-control systems are researched. The method for the taking into account of the restricted overshoot demand is suggested. The example of the use of modified by such way criterion for the third-order object is given. The optimization results with PID- regulator and with PIDD-regulator are compared. The discussed example for the modeling is taken from the practice of the laser system regulator design.

articleTitle: Impact optoelectronic nanosecond duration sensor
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The creation problem of optoelectronic sensor, working on amplitude-range principle is considered. It must to answer requirements to probability of false operation per passive aerosol noise. It is suggested to apply compact nanosecond pump oscillator of injection laser with impact avalanche diode. The experimental investigations results of sensor prototype distance characteristic curves are presented.

articleTitle: Dependence of the resistivity on orientation and size for the rectangular sample made from the conductive rectangular cell net
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Dependence of the resistivity on angle and size for the plane rectangular sample made from the conductive rectangular cell net is considered. It is shown that when the number of the net nodes inside the sample increases and when the ratio of the boundary nodes to the inside nodes decreases the resistivity tends to a value that can be considered as bulk value for the considered direction. It is found that while the rectangular net is geometrically symmetric for 180deg rotation the sample resistivity is symmetric for 90deg rotation.

articleTitle: Experimental definition of electromagnetic forces in dynamics of the electromagnetic mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The mode allowing to analyze of dynamic property of the electromagnetic mechanism on the basis of the general theory of the electric drive is proved. Are developed a technique, hardware and software for experimental definition of electromagnetic forces in dynamics of the electromagnetic mechanism. The proof of difference of electromagnetic forces in dynamics from electromagnetic forces considered according to existing rules of designing of electromagnetic mechanisms is submitted.

articleTitle: Compensation of finite zero set for multivariate systems with equal number of inputs and outputs in case control system designed by modal method
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: An approach for finite zero set compensation for multivariate systems with equal number of inputs and outputs is discussed in case of control system design by modal method where state feedback is used.

articleTitle: The testing hypotheses and construction forecasts for models in the form of systems of simultaneous equations
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The distribution of statistics Anderson-Rubin's and overriding criteria were studied, the procedure for constructing the interval forecasts endogenous variables was analyzed in violation the assumption of normality of noise and in the samples of finite size. Comparing the accuracy of forecasts was produced using different methods of estimating the reduced form.

articleTitle: Statistical methods to analyse failures of complex systems in presence of wear, fatigue and degradation: An engineering perspective in accelerated trials
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Dynamic regression models are exposed. They are well adapted to study the phenomena of longevity, aging, fatigue and degradation of complex system, and hence to be used in organization of the efficient statistical process of quality control in dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Evolution of multilevel voltage source inverters
publicationTitle: 2008 9th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The problem of increase in power and voltage of inverters today is provided more often by construction of multilevel voltage source inverters. The formation of an Instant curve of voltage of such inverter goes basically by the amplitude modulation with PWM added between the neighboring levels of the voltage of amplitude modulation. The known published English-speaking reviews on multilevel inverters do not cover all variety of circuits of inverters, they do not concern the prehistory of the problem and do not contain references to Russian-speaking publications. The given state-of-the-art review on circuitry of multilevel voltage source inverters, being based on our opportunity of access to the literature, contains the first attempt to capture the designated problem more fully. Besides the regular analysis of known circuits of inverters in the review recent innovative decisions on construction of step-up multilevel voltage source inverters on the basis of systems with switched capacitors are considered.
